item.title: Traffic resumes normal flow after Sarasota crash
item.description: 11:03 a.m. TuesdayAll lanes are reopened and traffic is flowing normally.9:17 a.m. TuesdaySarasota Police and fire-rescue units are working at the scene of a traffic crash on U.S. 41 at Bahia Vista Street, and southbound lanes are closed.Sarasota Police said drivers should avoid the area.Southbound lanes were shut down around 8:15 a.m. at Floyd Street, between Bahia Vista and the Sarasota Memorial Hospital campus.

item.title: Manatee County seeks public input on 2027 budget
item.description: Commissioner George Kruse described what the Manatee County government will look like if the state and voters opt to eliminate property taxes for homeowners. He said the county would stop buying conservation land through the Environmental Lands Management and Acquisition Program. Funding for children and veteran services would be cut. item.title: Longboat Key estate, designed by prominent architect, listed for $22M
item.description: A waterfront estate known as the "House of Columns" on Longboat Key has hit the market. Located on almost 5 acres at 6610 Gulf of Mexico Drive, the house encompasses nearly 7,000 square feet. Also included in the listing is 6630 Gulf of Mexico Drive, where the future owners could build a guest house or secondary structure. item.title: First step taken for ice rink to glide into Lakewood Ranch's Premier Sports Campus
item.description: On the heels of the Lakewood Ranch High School boys hockey team winning the Lightning Cup Feb. 6, Manatee County took its first step toward a public-private partnership to build an ice rink in Lakewood Ranch at Premier Sports Campus North. LWRHS hockey coach Peter Sibner said hockey is growing in the Tampa Bay area, but there aren’t enough rinks to support the sport’s growth.
